source_scope_excerpt: Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ ([[def-countable-choice]]), and use the finite regulated model type of [[def-qft-example-observable-types]]. Let $d\ge1$, let $\tau>0$ be a time interval endpoint in seconds, let $\hbar>0$ have unit $\mathrm{J\,s}$, and let $\lambda\in\mathbb R$ be dimensionless. Let $H_0=H_0^*\in M_d(\mathbb C)$ have unit joule and let $V:[0,\tau]\to M_d(\mathbb C)$ be norm-continuous, Hermitian-valued, and joule-valued. Set $$V_I(t)=e^{itH_0/\hbar}V(t)e^{-itH_0/\hbar},\qquad B=\sup_{0\le t\le\tau}\|V_I(t)\|,\qquad z=\frac{|\lambda|B\tau}{\hbar}.$$ Define $S_0(t)=I$ and $$S_{n+1}(t)=-\frac{i}{\hbar}\int_0^tV_I(r)S_n(r)\,dr,\qquad S(t)=\sum_{n=0}^\infty\lambda^nS_n(t).$$
